plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Endace network service device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, and interface traffic, for EndaceProbe (enterprise PEN 18418).
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart (sysUpTime). By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the Endace appliance and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Chassis CPU usage percent of the Endace visibility appliance (ENDACE-SYSTEM cpuUtil1, aggregated across CPUs as a one-minute rolling average, reported directly as a percentage). Sustained high CPU means the probe is near its processing capacity for packet capture and visibility.

metrics.name: cpu_load_1
metrics.description: One-minute CPU load of the Endace appliance (ENDACE-SYSTEM cpuLoad1, stored in hundredths and scaled by 1/100).

metrics.name: cpu_load_5
metrics.description: Five-minute CPU load of the Endace appliance (ENDACE-SYSTEM cpuLoad5, stored in hundredths and scaled by 1/100).

metrics.name: cpu_load_15
metrics.description: Fifteen-minute CPU load of the Endace appliance (ENDACE-SYSTEM cpuLoad15, stored in hundredths and scaled by 1/100).

metrics.name: disk_free_percent
metrics.description: Free space as a percent of total capacity for each mounted partition on the Endace appliance (ENDACE-SYSTEM mountBytesPercentFree, keyed by mountPoint). Low values indicate the capture or system volume is filling up.

metrics.name: device_raid_state
metrics.description: RAID controller status of the Endace appliance (ENDACE-SYSTEM raidStatusCode when present), normalized so ok is 1 and initializing, rebuilding, degraded, inoperable or unknown values are 2.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counters.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counters.
